PullRequest.Title: chat: restrict agent-customization skill to local sessions
PullRequest.Body:
Followup from https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/339817:

<!-- Thank you for submitting a Pull Request. Please:
* Read our Pull Request guidelines:
  https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/wiki/How-to-Contribute#pull-requests
* Associate an issue with the Pull Request.
* Ensure that the code is up-to-date with the `main` branch.
* Include a description of the proposed changes and how to test them.
-->

Restrict the extension-bundled `agent-customization` skill to `local` sessions by removing its `copilotcli` registration. This also removes its eligibility for Copilot Agent Host sessions. Other skills, harness registrations, and the skill content are unchanged.

Validation:
- `pnpm --dir extensions/copilot run test:unit src/platform/promptFiles/test/node/builtinSkills.spec.ts` — passed (3 tests).
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- Direct Node.js manifest comparison against HEAD before the commit — passed: only the requested session-type registration changed, and local registration is preserved.
- Build not run: this is a manifest-only change with no TypeScript changes.

Manual verification (not run): confirm the skill remains available in local Chat but is absent from Copilot Agent Host customizations in a fresh session.

Scenarios.Scenario: Local Chat discovers and advertises the bundled agent-customization skill
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Extension contribution registration validates the bundled SKILL.md, and the first local prompt collection requests the skill list before building the skills section. Both steps already existed and the retained local session type keeps the skill on this path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Read and parse the bundled SKILL.md during static skill contribution validation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One validation read for this contributed skill per registration lifecycle, independent of session type.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same file was registered and validated when sessionTypes contained both local and copilotcli.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Required before the contribution promise resolves on cold discovery; unchanged for local Chat.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Fetch skill DTOs from the workbench prompts service into the extension host via $provideSkills.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One cold IPC request for the full skill list, coalesced and cached across callers until invalidation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Identical one-request cached retrieval; the local filter included this skill before and still includes it.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: On the first local skill-list request; warm requests avoid the boundary.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: The number of registered/discovered skills; this diff changes no effective local cardinality because agent-customization remains included.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Static skill validation is represented by one contribution promise. Skill retrieval uses one CachedPromise-backed request, coalescing concurrent callers; local prompt assembly then filters the resolved in-memory list.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: On a cold extension-host request, getSkills crosses IPC once and resolves discovered skills; warm requests reuse CachedPromise until the existing change event invalidates it. The diff changes neither keys nor invalidation.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the changed array is propagated as metadata and local matching remains true; traced registration, cached IPC retrieval, and local filtering show no added work.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact skill count and cold discovery duration vary by installed extensions and workspace, but this manifest edit does not increase either.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. Local behavior and all expensive-boundary cardinalities are unchanged.

Scenarios.Scenario: Copilot CLI session creation resolves skill directories passed to the SDK session
Scenarios.CriticalPath: createSessionsOptions awaits getSkillsLocations in parallel with agent discovery, then passes deduplicated directory paths as SessionOptions.skillDirectories before SDK session creation.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Retrieve all discovered skill metadata for getSkillsLocations.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One cold coalesced IPC for the complete list; no per-skill IPC.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same cached full-list retrieval occurred before filtering.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Cold retrieval is awaited while constructing session options; warm retrieval uses the cache.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Pass the deduplicated skillDirectories array into Copilot CLI SDK session options.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One options payload per newly created session; directory cardinality is unchanged because other unconditional copilotcli skills remain under ./assets/prompts/skills.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: agent-customization contributed the same parent skill directory already contributed by troubleshoot and migrate-customizations; ResourceSet deduplicated it, so removing this skill does not reduce or increase the directory set.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The options are prepared before SDK session creation, but the diff does not add or enlarge the payload.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Configured skill roots plus distinct parent directories of Copilot-CLI-enabled file skills. Effective cardinality is by unique directory, not by skill.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Agent and skill-location discovery run in one Promise.all. Skill retrieval is coalesced by the shared CachedPromise; ResourceSet deduplicates directories before the SDK boundary.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Cold skill retrieval performs one cached IPC/discovery operation; warm session creations reuse the cached skill list. Directory derivation itself is in-memory per call.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the filter excludes this skill after the change, while directory-level deduplication and other copilotcli skills in the same parent prove no session-option or scan fan-out increase.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The SDK's downstream scanning cost depends on directory contents, but the exact directory set and SDK boundary cardinality remain unchanged by this edit.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The change removes eligibility but does not add latency, I/O, concurrency, or directory scanning on session creation.

Scenarios.Scenario: Copilot CLI / Agent Host customization UI requests available customization items
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The customization provider awaits agents, instructions, skills, hooks, and plugins concurrently, then returns their metadata to the chat session customization consumer.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Fetch the full skill DTO list from the workbench prompts service.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One cold cached request for all skills, concurrent with the other four category requests; no per-skill IPC.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same full skill list was fetched, then agent-customization passed the copilotcli filter and was mapped into one item.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Awaited as one branch of customization enumeration; unchanged by this metadata edit.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Return customization item metadata to the chat-session customization consumer.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One aggregate array per provider request; the changed behavior contains one fewer skill item.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: One additional agent-customization metadata object was included.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The aggregate list must be produced before the customization UI can consume it; the diff slightly reduces work and payload size.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: The number of discovered customization metadata entries. This diff decreases the returned skills list by one for copilotcli sessions.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Five customization categories run in one Promise.all. Skills use a single cached full-list request followed by an in-memory filter and map; there is no per-item boundary call.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Cold skills access performs the shared cached discovery IPC; warm requests reuse it. Filtering by sessionTypes happens after retrieval, so the change does not alter cold boundary work but reduces one mapped/serialized result item.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the provider implementation explicitly filters with isEnabledForCopilotCLI after cached retrieval and maps only matching skills.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The total customization count varies by workspace, but the direction is definitively non-regressive because one item is removed and no request is added.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The only changed performance effect is a negligible reduction in returned metadata and mapping work.

Analysis.Summary: Reviewed the complete one-file, one-hunk manifest diff and traced local skill discovery, Copilot CLI session setup, and Agent Host/customization enumeration through filesystem validation, cached workbench-to-extension-host IPC, in-memory filtering, directory deduplication, and SDK option construction. The removed copilotcli session type adds no work or retained state and does not change effective skill-directory cardinality. No valid performance findings or evidenced shipped regression fix.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
